title: onprem airgap: offline bundle vendoring for rke2 ubuntu-22.04 + apt-mirror rollback tooling
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: Customers running the Private on-prem installer on RKE2+Ubuntu 22.04 in air-gapped environments have reported failures during OS-level package restores and inconsistent apt mirror states after point-in-time upgrades. This change vendors a curated offline bundle for RKE2+Ubuntu-22.04, integrates a tested apt-mirror snapshot/restore flow into the airgap tooling, and adds rollback helpers to make OS package reverts deterministic. What changed: 1) Added vendor tarball: private-installer/airgap/bundles/rke2/ubuntu-22.04/offline-bundle-v2026-02-10.tar.gz (sha256 pinned). 2) Apt mirror tooling: scripts/airgap/apt-mirror/snapshot.sh and restore.sh to create deterministic snapshots of apt repos and to restore them on target nodes. 3) Installer integration: private-installer/airgap/installer/ubuntu/apt-restore-hook.yaml and bootstrap hooks to run restores during upgrade/rollback flows. 4) Helm chart updates: charts/redwood-private/templates/preflight-job.yaml now validates apt snapshot presence and verifies checksums before proceeding. 5) Rollback tooling: tools/rollback/apt-rollback.sh and docs/runbooks/apt-rollback.md describing manual and automated rollback steps. 6) CI: added a dedicated offline bundle validation job in .github/workflows/airgap-validate.yml. Backwards compatibility: the new hooks are opt-in via installer config (airgap.aptSnapshot.enabled). Default behavior is unchanged for customers not using apt snapshots. Testing: validated end-to-end on RKE2 (v1.28) + Ubuntu 22.04 VMs in our perf-canary infra, exercised upgrade->rollback path and verified package state and service reconciliation. Checklist: [x] vendor bundle created and checksumed [x] snapshot/restore scripts unit tested [x] installer integration tested in canary cluster [x] docs and runbook added [x] CI validation job added Migration notes: operators who upgrade should run the snapshot script before performing maintenance or upgrades and set airgap.aptSnapshot.enabled=true to enable automatic restores. Links: Linear ENG-3214, internal runbook: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-3214, example helms values in docs/values/ubuntu-apt-snapshot.example.yml
